text:
sam: Planning a rolling reboot + driver tweak in eu-west2 on 2024-07-10 02:00-02:30 UTC. Target: small rack cohort (eu-rack-7). Goal: fix TCP stall on long-lived GPU streams. Plan: canary 1 rack -> preheat KV -> drain 2 nodes concurrently -> reboot -> verify metrics.

ops-bot: Maintenance created: 2024-07-10T02:00:00Z -> 2024-07-10T02:30:00Z. Max concurrency=2. Notifications enabled. :bell:

nina: Confirming we exclude Dedicated/reserved pools (tag: reserved=true). Will update exclude list.

maria: Sequence by rack only to avoid cross-rack backfill cold KV. Good to prefer same-AZ warm standbys.

sam: Preheat: 6 priming pods per pool, start 10m prior; seed top-20 prompts.

sre-jen: Canary checks: abort if any of: request-error >2% (10m), token P95 > baseline+35ms (10m), packet-drop >0.6% (sustained 10m). On abort -> revert driver and steer to fallback pool.

tim: Cost impact note: estimated worst-case spill ~1.8k credits; tracing/retention ~8% spike. Ops budget notified.

customer-success: We'll send short customer notices to impacted long-run jobs in eu-west2 and attach status link.

ops-bot: @oncall added: ena_sre. 10m pre-start reminder will be sent.

sam: Thanks — go/no-go posted 10m prior with canary node IDs. Keep channel open for live updates. :white_check_mark:
